title: Shakedown
summary: Three ganger types lean on a cart vendor in Heywood, and V decides whether to talk them off or fight.
description: Three ganger types are leaning on a cart vendor in Heywood. Johnny thinks it is V's call what happens next, and he says so bluntly.

start.bringUp: Johnny sees a cart vendor being leaned on in Heywood. Bring up, in your own way and blunt, that V should walk over to the street cart in Vista del Rey, because it is V's call and not his.

cart.name: a street cart in Vista del Rey, Heywood

g1.asks: Hit them or talk them? I'd hit them. That's why I'm dead.
g1.know: Three punks are leaning on the cart vendor for protection money. They may be teens with toy guns. V can talk them off or fight, and the vendor must end unhurt.
g1.secret: Part of him wants V to lose his temper.

stages.label: Deal with the three punks at the cart
stages.objective: Help Johnny deal with the three punks at the Vista del Rey cart
stages.know: Three ganger types lean on a cart vendor for money. They are relaxed until someone starts a fight, and the vendor is frightened but unhurt.
stages.wants: V to talk the punks off or fight them, with the vendor unhurt.

do.who: the leader of three ganger types

talk.memory: You talked three punks off a cart vendor in Heywood, and Johnny gave you a grudging nod.

fight.memory: You fought three punks on a cart vendor's street in Heywood, and Johnny warned you about it.

variations.know: A flower stall stands in place of the cart, and the punks want the stall owner's money.
A food truck at night stands in place of the cart, with the same three punks.
A fixer's courier is ambushed instead of the vendor, and the punks want the package.
